_comment: Copied to <project>/.claude/ghorc.json. Missing keys use the code defaults; docs/configuration.md lists every key.

checks._comment: Project check commands: agents run fast, the lead runs full.

_comment_heavyCommands: Regexes of commands subagents may not run, e.g. "^npm\s+run\s+test:e2e\b". /ghorc:setup proposes them.

thresholds._comment: Lead context in tokens: ctxPrepare - refresh STATE; ctxHandoff - hand the shift over.

watchdog._comment: true: SessionStart starts the transcript watchdog (off by default; stop it with scripts/watchdog.cjs --stop).

readGuard._comment: How many reads of one file are allowed between edits of it.
